preopening_rows_handling.training: Excluded pre-opening zero rows based on earliest positive sale date per store (55,308 rows dropped post-2015)
preopening_rows_handling.evaluation: 0 pre-opening rows in evaluation; all stores open prior to test origin (Store 52 opened 2017-04-20)

simulation_window.window_reconciliation: Total layout is exactly 96 calendar days (2017-05-12 to 2017-08-15: 5 folds x 16d = 80d + 16d holdout = 96d). Warmup excludes first 14 days (2017-05-12 to 2017-05-25), yielding exactly 82 evaluated days (2017-05-26 to 2017-08-15). There are exactly 14 weekly review dates (indices 0, 7, 14, ..., 91). The earlier report mention of '91 days / 77 evaluated days' arose from conflating the last review day index t=91 (91 - 14 = 77) with total days.

parameters.extrapolation_handling: Using per-review-date re-forecasting (stitching_rule='reforecast') with 16-day horizon covering R+L=10d and 14d without proportional scaling. End-of-window forecasts extended through 2017-08-31 via test.csv onpromotion.
parameters.safety_stock_construction: Strictly out-of-sample forecast errors from earlier origins whose actuals are observed prior to review date t. Assumes independent errors with daily sigma * sqrt(R+L); empirical ratio of window-sum error std to daily sigma * sqrt(R+L) is reported under empirical_window_sum_error_ratios.
parameters.data_limitations: Favorita has no inventory data; sales are a demand proxy and are censored by stockouts, so fill rates are optimistic; results are assumption-driven.
